verses.kjv: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.modern: A prophecy concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

verses.kjv: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
verses.modern: God is jealous, and the LORD takes vengeance. The LORD takes vengeance and is filled with fury. The LORD will take vengeance on His adversaries, and He reserves wrath for His enemies.

verses.kjv: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.modern: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked. The LORD has His way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of His feet.

verses.kjv: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
verses.modern: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry; He dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languishes.

verses.kjv: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
verses.modern: The mountains quake at Him, and the hills melt. The earth is burned at His presence — the world, and all who live in it.

verses.kjv: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
verses.modern: Who can stand before His indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by Him.

verses.kjv: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
verses.modern: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and He knows those who trust in Him.

verses.kjv: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
verses.modern: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an utter end of its place, and darkness will pursue His enemies.

verses.kjv: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
verses.modern: What do You plot against the LORD? He will make an utter end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.

verses.kjv: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
verses.modern: For while they are tangled together like thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they will be devoured like stubble fully dry.

verses.kjv: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
verses.modern: One has come out from You who plots evil against the LORD — a wicked counselor of Belial.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "Though they be at peace, and likewise many, even so they will be cut down when He passes through. Though I have afflicted You, I will afflict You no more.

verses.kjv: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
verses.modern: For now I will break His yoke from off You, and I will burst Your bonds apart."

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
verses.modern: The LORD has given a commandment concerning You: "No more of Your name will be sown. Out of the house of Your gods I will cut off the carved image and the molten image. I will make Your grave, for You are vile."

verses.kjv: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
verses.modern: See on the mountains the feet of him who brings good tidings, who proclaims peace! O Judah, keep your solemn feasts and perform your vows. The wicked will no more pass through you; he is utterly cut off.

chapters.summary: The LORD is a jealous God who avenges and is furious — He will not acquit the wicked. He is longsuffering, but His way is in the whirlwind and the storm. He is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and He knows those who trust in Him. Nineveh's destruction is decreed — the LORD will make an utter end of her.

verses.kjv: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
verses.modern: He who dashes in pieces has come up against your face. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace Your loins, fortify Your power mightily.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
verses.modern: For the LORD will restore the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel — for the emptiers have emptied them out and marred their vine branches.

verses.kjv: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
verses.modern: The shield of His mighty men is made red; the valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots are with flaming torches in the day of His preparation, and the fir spears are terribly shaken.

verses.kjv: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
verses.modern: The chariots rage in the streets; they jostle one against another in the broad ways. They seem like torches; they run like the lightnings.

verses.kjv: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
verses.modern: He calls together His nobles; they stumble in their walk. They make haste to the wall, and the defense is prepared.

verses.kjv: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
verses.modern: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

verses.kjv: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
verses.modern: And Huzzab will be led away captive; she will be brought up, and her maids will lead her with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

verses.kjv: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
verses.modern: But Nineveh of old is like a pool of water, yet they flee away. "Stand! Stand!" they will cry, but none looks back.

verses.kjv: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
verses.modern: Take the spoil of silver! Take the spoil of gold! There is no end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

verses.kjv: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
verses.modern: She is empty, and void, and waste. The heart melts; the knees strike together; much pain is in all loins; and the faces of them all gather blackness.

verses.kjv: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
verses.modern: Where is the dwelling of the lions, the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, with none to make them afraid?

verses.kjv: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
verses.modern: The lion tore in pieces enough for His whelps, and strangled for His lionesses, and filled His holes with prey, and His dens with ravin.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.modern: "I am against You," says the LORD of hosts. "I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour Your young lions. I will cut off Your prey from the earth, and the voice of Your messengers will be heard no more."

chapters.summary: The destroyer advances against Nineveh — chariots race through the streets like lightning, the gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace dissolves. The city that was once the den of lions is plundered and emptied. The LORD of hosts declares He is against her, and her chariots will burn in the smoke.

verses.kjv: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
verses.modern: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery; the prey never departs.

verses.kjv: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
verses.modern: The noise of a whip, the noise of rattling wheels, of prancing horses and bounding chariots!

verses.kjv: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
verses.modern: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the glittering spear. There is a crowd of slain, and a great number of carcasses; there is no end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses.

verses.kjv: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
verses.modern: All because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, who sells nations through her whoredoms and families through her witchcrafts.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
verses.modern: "I am against You," says the LORD of hosts. "I will uncover Your skirts over Your face; I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

verses.kjv: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
verses.modern: I will cast abominable filth on You, and make You vile, and set You as a gazingstock.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
verses.modern: And it will come to pass that all who look on You will flee from You and say, 'Nineveh is laid waste — who will bemoan her?' From where shall I seek comforters for You?"

verses.kjv: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
verses.modern: Are You better than populous No, that was situated among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

verses.kjv: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
verses.modern: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were Your helpers.

verses.kjv: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.modern: Yet she was carried away; she went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets. They cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

verses.kjv: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
verses.modern: You also will be drunken; You will be hid; You also will seek strength because of the enemy.

verses.kjv: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.modern: All Your strongholds will be like fig trees with the firstripe figs — if they be shaken, they will even fall into the mouth of the eater.

verses.kjv: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
verses.modern: See, Your people in the midst of You are women. The gates of Your land will be set wide open to Your enemies; the fire will devour Your bars.

verses.kjv: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
verses.modern: Draw water for the siege; fortify Your strongholds. Go into the clay, tread the mortar, make strong the brickkiln.

verses.kjv: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
verses.modern: There the fire will devour You; the sword will cut You off; it will eat You up like the cankerworm. Make Yourself many as the cankerworm; make Yourself many as the locusts.

verses.kjv: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
verses.modern: You have multiplied Your merchants more than the stars of heaven. The cankerworm strips the land and flies away.

verses.kjv: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.modern: Your crowned ones are like the locusts, and Your captains like the great grasshoppers that camp in the hedges in the cold day — but when the sun rises, they flee away, and no one knows the place where they are.

verses.kjv: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
verses.modern: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; Your nobles dwell in the dust. Your people are scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathers them.

verses.kjv: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
verses.modern: There is no healing of Your bruise; Your wound is grievous. All who hear the bruit of You clap their hands over You — for on whom has Your wickedness not passed continually?

chapters.summary: Woe to the bloody city of Nineveh — full of lies, robbery, and endless prey. The crack of whips, the rumble of wheels, the flash of swords fill the streets. She was the mistress of witchcrafts who sold nations through her whoredoms. No fortress will save her, no army will deliver her — all who hear the news of her fall will clap their hands, for who has not felt her endless cruelty?
